question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. average hourly earnings of all private employees (BLS, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for July 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-07-14) be above 4.15%, its value for March 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-04-15 (March 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
